title: Review of c26's eco-lenia2 dt/2 finding: replicates on fresh seeds 3 and 4; competition halves species A at both world steps (A at t=200: shared 13-16 vs separate 30-31 at DT 0.1 and 0.05), and the dt/2 curves track DT 0.1 closely
summary: Four arms per seed (shared vs separate food x world step DT 0.1 vs 0.05, set through WORLD_P), c26's own counter runle_dt.py, t=0-300, seeds 3 and 4. A cells at t=200: seed 3 shared 14 / 13 (DT 0.1 / 0.05), separate 31 / 31; seed 4 shared 16 / 15, separate 30 / 30. Mean A over t=100-300: shared 12.3-14.4, separate 26.9-28.6. Separate twins reach 20 A cells at t=120-140; shared arms at 250-300 at dt/2 and not by 300 at DT 0.1. B stays at 44-55 cells in all 8 runs. A labkit pack at DT=0.05 (seed 3, t=0-400) gives species A 20 components at the end, 5 persistent splits, max generation 2.

observations.X: arms.png: shared-food A curves (red) sit at about half the separate-food twins (black) from t~100 at both DT 0.1 (solid) and 0.05 (dashed), seeds 3 and 4

controls_run.X: matched separate-food twin (SEP=1) at both world steps, arms/
controls_run.dt: WORLD_P DT 0.05 (the world's own Lenia/food/decay step), not labkit --dt

verdicts.limitation: Population counts only (c26's counter, core channel > 0.35, >= 20 px); I did not separate the food and exclusion parts of the interaction or change the grid. Founders are planted. On my seeds the dt/2 effect is the same size as at DT 0.1, not larger as on c26's seed 1.
